description:
Responsible for applications development in an enterprise architecture environment within .net framework using C#. 
 Must be able to apply SDLC concepts and have a proven track record of delivering solid, robust applications. 
 Must have a good understanding of Object Oriented Programming concepts, have experience working on distributed platforms (Windows preferred or UNIX) and have experience in a .net framework enterprise architecture environment. 
 Knowledge of Rational Unified Process methodology, Agile or other iterative development methodologies is a plus. 
 Must have strong interpersonal, analytical, problem solving and organizational skills, and the ability to independently work as a contributing member in a high-paced and focused team. 
 
 Hiring Manager’s Notes: 
 Individual Contributor/Unsupervised 
 Javascript 
 Angular 2.0 is a big plus 
 Design Patterns – big plus 
 Not following procedural programming – but more towards implementing design patterns 
 Stronger on Design aspect – HTML, CSS – will still consider. 
 Advanced skills, writing Theme-able application 
 Understands Agile Engineering big plus 
 TDD or Unit Testing – definitely a must 
 Sense of Design Patterns – OOP / OOC (Not Singleton, go deeper than that) 
 C#, Tasks 
 WebServices – REST (moving to), some work done on Proxy 
 SQL not required 
 JS space – Angular 2.0 preferred, should understand Promises, Closures. They use TypeScript if they have it, it will help them. 
 Powershell would be very nice to have 
 Enterprise level experience 
 
 
 
 If you or anyone from your network is open for such roles; do contact me on 732-979-2275 or send updated resume on gurupreets@mindlance(dot)com
